summary: Turn community feedback into trackable recovery plans, partner actions and progress reports. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Disaster recovery training helps recovery practitioners turn community input and changing needs into workable, accountable recovery actions. Designed for recovery managers, coordinators and community engagement officers, it covers participatory needs assessment, accessible consultation, feedback and complaints referral, partner coordination, and progress reporting. Exercises include mapping stakeholders and service gaps, maintaining decision and feedback records, and developing a recovery plan with owners, resources and measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate disaster recovery practitioners who coordinate recovery delivery, consult affected communities or report implementation progress. It suits roles that must connect community feedback to partner actions and practical recovery decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating disaster recovery planning, community consultation or recovery delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
